decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already records the required no-code reward package, random assignment, per-mint frequency, and recipient pairing.
The source does not change the NFT mint number used as a referral code, its persistence, or its display locations.
The source distinguishes coded and no-code reward accounting but does not change which referral codes are valid or the self-referral rule.
The existing same-message MODIFY captures the accounting surfaces and ticket-commission pairing but omits the source-time requirement to backfill missing historical no-code rewards.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
So far, we have done 12 mints, that should equal 12 tickets & 12 x $5 commissions.

**When there is no referral code used, there is still a ticket and commission**.

Right now, **when a code is used**, it is correctly accounted for on the leaderboards/NFT attributes. Perfect.

When there is **no referral code used**, the ticket and commission are randomly assigned.
(B**ut they still need to be accounted for on the leaderboard/NFT attributes**.)

I think since your last fix, (on the last 2 mints) the randomly assigned tickets have been accounted for on the leaderboard/NFT attributes. Great.
But they have not been backfilled to show the missing tickets.

And the commissions (from these no code buys) are still not being accounted for on the leaderboard/NFT attributes.

In my screenshot you'll see i have an NFT with 2 tickets and only 1 x $5 commission - this should be impossible, as every ticket comes with a $5 commission.

And on my leaderboard screenshot, you can count (from 12 total mints) 7 tickets and 5 x $5 commissions accounted for.
12 mints should equal 12 tickets and 12 x $5 commissions, regardless of a referral code being used or not.

value_updates.ticket_commission_pairing: Each accounted referral ticket must have its corresponding $5 commission accounted to the same recipient NFT.
value_updates.historical_random_reward_backfill: Backfill missing tickets and $5 commissions from prior no-code primary mints so historical accounting reflects one paired ticket and commission per mint.

decisions.reason: Random assignment of no-code referral rewards is separate from selection of prize-draw winners and does not change the draw-selection method.
A same-message MODIFY already requires leaderboard totals to include every primary mint, including no-code random rewards, with paired tickets and commissions.
The source confirms ticket issuance for no-code mints but does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, draw trigger, or eligible draw population.
The source does not change ticket counters, eligibility windows, expiration, or post-draw reset behavior; no-code issuance is owned by the separate reward requirement.
The client explicitly requires NFT attributes to account for randomly assigned no-code tickets and their corresponding $5 commissions, which is absent from the candidate state.

decisions.reason: The candidate already assigns $5 per primary mint to the referral commission; the source changes reward routing and accounting rather than the revenue split.
The source concerns reward totals and NFT attributes, not which NFTs are owned or displayed on the dashboard.
The source assumes completed mints and changes their reward handling and accounting, not NFT asset delivery or mint fulfillment.
